projects.originalDescription: Tokens管理平台，调度管理号池将各大国外AI平台的模型转化为OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini等平台的API接口标准格式，支持Claude Code、Codex、GeminiCli等终端调用

projects.name: ds-contracts-poc
projects.description: Component contracts: one machine-readable source of truth that generates both a React library and a Figma library, proves they match with a three-way differ, extracts contracts back out of existing code or designs, and runs the whole loop in a browser playground. Candidate spec for design-system contracts.

projects.name: neuro-oj
projects.description: An online judging and competition platform for AI Olympiads and certifications (IOAI / NOAI / LMCC). It supports objective questions, coding problems, LLM engineering problems, and artifact submission evaluation (Kaggle-style).
projects.originalDescription: 面向 AI 奥林匹克与认证（IOAI / NOAI / LMCC）的在线评测与竞赛平台：支持客观题、代码题、LLM 工程题与产物提交（类 Kaggle）评测。

projects.name: markgitup-research-desk
projects.description: Autonomous hourly research desk: a local LLM picks a fresh angle from 24 standing AI/policy/markets topic families, SearXNG gathers the evidence, and nothing publishes without 2+ independent sources. Static site, zero dependencies, built with Hermes Agent.
